about: Time Reveals All Lose yourself in the world of New York, 2329, where immortality comes at a price that someone has to pay.
Following a near-death experience, Detective James Karra takes an off-the-books case from his chief with only the help of a young police liaison, Sara Kai, to assist him.
Time reveals all as they risk everything in pursuit of a killer, uncovering the dark secrets of the city's elite.

Welcome to New York 2329 – Experience a noir adventure in an alternate future of New York City in 2329; technology has advanced to offer humans eternal life, allowing consciousness to be stored in memory banks or transferred from one body to…
That is, if you can afford the subscription.
